scripts.start: bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail; trim() { printf %s "$1" | tr -d "\r" | sed -e "s/^[[:space:]]*//" -e "s/[[:space:]]*$//"; }; export DATABASE_URL="$(trim "$(printenv DATABASE_URL 2>/dev/null)")"; export DATABASE_URL_SOURCE="DATABASE_URL"; if ! echo "$DATABASE_URL" | grep -Eq "^(postgresql|postgres)://"; then for v in INTERNAL_DATABASE_URL EXTERNAL_DATABASE_URL Internal_Database_URL External_Database_URL POSTGRES_URL POSTGRESQL_URL RENDER_POSTGRES_URL; do val="$(trim "$(printenv "$v" 2>/dev/null)")"; if echo "$val" | grep -Eq "^(postgresql|postgres)://"; then export DATABASE_URL="$val"; export DATABASE_URL_SOURCE="$v"; break; fi; done; fi; if ! echo "$DATABASE_URL" | grep -Eq "^(postgresql|postgres)://"; then safe=$(echo "$DATABASE_URL" | sed -E "s#(postgres(ql)?://)[^@]*@#\\1***:***@#"); echo "ERROR: invalid DATABASE_URL (source=${DATABASE_URL_SOURCE:-none}): ${safe}" 1>&2; exit 1; fi; export API_INTERNAL_PORT="${API_INTERNAL_PORT:-3001}"; npm --workspace @unitedlinkgroup/database run db:push:deploy; API_PORT="$API_INTERNAL_PORT" npm --workspace api run start:prod & api_pid=$!; npm --workspace web run start -- -H 0.0.0.0 -p "${PORT:-3000}" & web_pid=$!; trap "kill $api_pid $web_pid 2>/dev/null || true" EXIT; wait -n $api_pid $web_pid'
